draft_en.subject: A MICROSENS-labelled industrial 8-PoE + 2-SFP in white housing - the volume question
draft_en.body:
Hello Anke,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 22 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For a MICROSENS-labelled industrial managed switch in your white housing colour: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW in standard housing (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 10G media converter, 1 x 10G SFP+ + 1 x 100M-10G RJ45 - $65. White housing is a tooling and minimum-lot question, not a yes/no.

One question: what annual volume would the white-housing SKU run at, so I check tooling and the minimum lot with the factory before we talk further?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
